facts.fact: The ministry's December 2025 communiqué, cited by Agence Ecofin, followed the award of a licence to Starlink in CAF.

Starlink announced on 16 March 2026 the commercial availability of its service in CAF, in partnership with hardware distributor DEVEA Centrafrique, at 33,000 FCFA a month plus 19% VAT, with a standard kit at 240,000 FCFA and a Mini kit at 123,000 FCFA.
